people.name: Apollos
people.line: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul

translations.web: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
translations.bsb: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
translations.kjv: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
translations.asv: I planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
